headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 21, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds secured a 9-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Andrew Abbott earning the win. Sal Stewart led the Reds' offense, hitting 4 home runs, including a key 12th homer that scored JJ Bleday. In other action, the Tampa Bay Rays took down the Baltimore Orioles 5-3, with Jesse Scholtens earning the win and Ian Seymour notching the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Victor Vodnik of the Colorado Rockies, who was placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation. Ben Williamson of the Tampa Bay Rays was also placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 17, 2026, with a low back strain. Other injured players include Kyle Teel of the Chicago White Sox, Lance McCullers Jr. of the Houston Astros, James McCann of the Arizona Diamondbacks, Joe Mantiply of the Toronto Blue Jays, and Clay Holmes of the New York Mets.

Several teams made notable roster moves, including the Cincinnati Reds, who traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn, while the Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Twins in 4-1 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins took down the Houston Astros 4-1, securing a crucial win. Ryan Kreidler led the Astros' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs, while Joe Ryan pitched 6 strong innings for the Twins, striking out 9 batters.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Rockies in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a narrow win over the Colorado Rockies, with Jacob Latz earning the win after pitching 2.0 scoreless innings. Ezequiel Duran led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers in their recent matchup. Impact players for the Guardians included Patrick Bailey, Brayan Rocchio, and Dillon Dingler, while Joey Cantillo stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cardinals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Brandon Lowe and Marcell Ozuna standing out among the impact hitters. Braxton Ashcraft and Dustin May led the Pirates' pitching effort.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Victor Vodnik Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation.

top_news.title: **Reds Acquire Right-Hander Zach McCambley**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds have made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley in exchange for outfielder Rece Hinds.
